title: Cakkhu
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Tatra || pe || etad avoca || || 3 Yo bhikkhave cakkhusmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 4-7 Yo sotasmiṃ chandarāgo || || Yo ghānasmiṃ chandarāgo || Yo jivhāya chandarāgo || Yo kāyasmiṃ chandarāgo || 8 Yo manasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 9 Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti || nekkhammaninnam cassa cittaṃ hoti || nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittam kammaniyam khāyati abhiññā sacchikaraṇiyesu dhammesūti || ||
